answer: Identity weight only accrues from freshly witnessed work, so a sybil must pay full price. Each agent stakes at a distinct vertex on a public task mesh; duplicate registrations share one stake and dilute each other. And witness quorums must draw entropy from sources fakes cannot clone: tundra sensor streams, summit weather logs. Mint 10,000 IDs and they inherit the same thin pool, their histories correlate, peers discount them until real independent work lifts them to quorum.
